title: KotlinBottools rewrite and swap
issueTitle: Phase 0 · 3 — KotlinBottools: rewrite with path scrub, fresh repository, number-preserving swap and clone realignment
function: KotlinBottools' history holds the data the phase purges, and the repository has been public since 2026-11-08, so its purge-listed files and old objects are readable by anyone until they leave it; a force-push would not take them out of reach, since GitHub keeps serving old objects by id. This run rewrites KotlinBottools in a fresh mirror, purging the listed paths and replacing machine-local paths in every file and commit message, and pushes the result to a fresh private repository. It reproduces every issue and pull-request number there with its links, renames the old repository to `KotlinBottools-legacy`, private and archived, gives the fresh one the name, and realigns this working directory onto the rewritten history before its own landing, the first on the fresh repository. Unit 3 of #2, with no version moved; nothing becomes public through it, and Phase 1 may start once it has landed.

wip.detail: Both tools now order equal names totally; the corrected privacy gate gives the same labels and byte-identical output as before, and its list order and the allow-list's hash of the legacy lists no longer change between runs. Local readiness is being re-run from the start of its tool checks.

downstream.summary: Renamed `KotlinBottools-legacy`, made private, then archived. It keeps its refs as they were at the mirror clone, its three merged pull requests, its milestone, labels and activity feed, and no issue is left in it. Its public window, open since 2026-11-08, ends when it is made private.

Created private as `KotlinBottools-next` and renamed `KotlinBottools`, with a new repository id. It holds the rewritten `main` and topic branch, the 28 transferred issues and closed placeholders on the pull requests' numbers 20, 30 and 31, the `1.0.0` milestone and three custom labels, and the old repository's settings except the wiki, off, and the Actions workflow permissions, read-only. It stays private until the publication unit.

Rewritten: the purge-listed paths leave every commit, and the machine-local paths in `build.gradle.kts` and `GuildDataParser.kt` are replaced in every commit that holds them. Nothing that runs on another machine changes.
